newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen, Krupp shares restart sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen, Krupp shares restart sharply up.

text.p: Shares in Thyssen AG and Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp restarted on the IBIS electronic trading system on Thursday after having been suspended on Tuesday and Wednesday.
Shares in Thyssen climbed to 390.50 marks compared to their March 17 IBIS close of 344.50, while Krupp stock was at 306 marks against 270 marks.

Krupp earlier this week launched a hostile takeover bid for Thyssen with an offer at 435 marks per share before both sides announced on Wednesday they would first explore cooperation possibilities in their steel businesses.
Thyssen shares had risen close to the 435 mark level in unofficial "grey" trade on Wednesday before falling back to around 413 marks after news of the cooperation talks.
